Review the actual roster

After-only evidence: authenticated MHKY/2026-27 Preview/Apply in the isolated environment produced 26 active members. No signatures were created by this import check.

Signing and recovery on iPad

After-only visual evidence at 1180×820. Chromium uses iPad detection and pen-class CDP input; save responses are intercepted. The original full-page capture was 1180×960, so it is not presented as a matched visual pair. Physical Pencil, touch, rotation, and Safari acceptance remain open.

Management stays recoverable

After-only fixtures: server settingsLocked=true with no current artifacts, followed by a simulated reset failure. This proves UI recovery, not real erasure.

What changed, and why

Keep the version that the signer started with

Was

Reconnect could move an in-progress draft from capture version 0 onto version 1, weakening stale-save protection.

Now

The browser keeps version 0 and its ink, receives a conflict, and requires deliberate reopening before replacing another capture.

Make shared and retained signature state consistent

Was

An erased canonical signature could fall back to an old team artifact; removed-member history was hard to reach; cleanup skipped historical committed operations.

Now

Canonical blank state stays authoritative, Removed from roster exposes retained history, and pending-delete cleanup can retry after erasure.

Fence destructive lifecycle actions and bound exports

Was

A new save did not advance the collection version; ZIP size was checked after files were buffered, and case-only names could collide on extraction.

Now

Every commit advances the collection version. ZIP reads stop at the 50 MiB budget and names are unique without case sensitivity.

Verification

  • 125 focused tests pass, including shared AppShell consumers. Nine regression cases fail as expected against the original service implementation (eight lifecycle cases plus the streaming budget check).
  • TypeScript and scoped ESLint pass. The controlled optimized app build generates 262 pages.
  • Authenticated browser checks cover real Preview/Apply, collapsed search and filters, locked settings/reset failure fixtures, reconnect version retention, non-JSON response handling, timeout recovery, and viewport fit. Keyboard Space toggles a filtered group without losing its matching row.
  • The live-test runner passed read-only preflight: exact preview branch, isolated storage configured, and ADHOC/2032-33 unused. Execution remains pending explicit approval.

Things to know

  • Full-repository ESLint has an existing error in vendored public/qrcode/vendor/jsQR.js. Unrelated dirty work is preserved.
  • Real new private artifact save/download/erase/reset/archive acceptance is prepared in live-test-plan.md, but automatic approval review rejected execution without explicit authorization.
  • No commit, push, deployment, production mutation, or physical-device claim is made.
